name: smwmusic-touhou-yumejikuu-phantasmagoria-of-dim-dream-victory-demonstration
title: Touhou Yumejikuu ~ Phantasmagoria of Dim. Dream - Victory Demonstration
description:
The jingle in Touhou 3: Phantasmagoria of Dim. Dream that plays when you defeat an opponent. How is this the only game to even have this victory theme when the other games could've benefited from it. Included a bass channel (since the original game didn't have one).

Great for... stage clear and world clear themes obviously.

Note:
There's an option to enable or disable the goal sfx. By default, it is turned on.
